title: Rory and the Sleepy Amber Shore
verses:
The sun tumbled down past the edge of the hill,
As twilight was painting the shore,
The water grew sleepy and misty and still,
Where Rory walked softly once more.

Then Benny stepped slow on the velvety sand,
And tilted his head to the breeze,
While Psittaco nestled right into his hand,
Away from the rustle of trees.

High over the ripples flew Nia so light,
To land where the rushes were deep,
And Ricky came trotting to welcome the night,
For even the quickest must sleep.

Then Tilly found pebbles of amber that glowed,
Like stars that had fallen to rest,
Beside where the silvery river had flowed,
To fashion a pillowy nest.

Now Rory curled under the canopy wide,
Surrounded by friends in the bay,
With Benny and Tilly asleep at his side,
To dream of another bright day.

The silver moon drifted across the dark blue,
And covered the shore in a gleam,
While slumber was falling like lavender dew,
To carry them into a dream.
